article.story: THIBODAUX, La. -- — Keon Thompson had 20 points to guide Stepen F. Austin to a 79-62 victory over Nicholls on Monday night. Thompson shot 8 of 10 from the field and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Lumberjacks (16-3, 9-1 Southland Conference). Ahamed Mohammed added 15 points and Chrishawn Christmas scored 10. Jaylen Searles led the Colonels (8-11, 7-3) with 22 points and eight rebounds. Jalik Dunkley totaled 12 points and eight rebounds. Trae English also scored 12. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
